validity.recommendation: Change Owner/Operator from 'General Petroleum Co' (100%) to Khalda Petroleum Company (KPC), the Apache(operator)+EGPC JV that operates the Qasr field and the greater Khalda Concession. GPC appears mis-copied from the same cited article's SOUTHERN Western Desert (Abu Sennan) paragraph.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM lists Owner1 = 'General Petroleum Co' at 100%. That is almost certainly wrong. Qasr is one of the largest gas-condensate fields in the northern Western Desert (Shushan-Matrouh basin), discovered by Apache in 2003 and developed inside the greater Khalda Concession. Oil & Gas Journal states plainly 'Apache operates Khalda with a 100% contractor interest' and places Qasr on the Khalda concession. GulfPub PE World Map's counterpart record ('Qasr GP - Shams Pipeline', operating, 24 in) gives operator = Khalda Petroleum Company (KPC) — the Apache/EGPC JV. Two independent origins (OGJ editorial + GulfPub) agree the field/pipeline is Khalda/Apache, not GPC. Notably, the sheet's OWN cited source (Egypt Oil & Gas, 'The Western Desert', March 2020 Issue 159) only names 'General Petroleum Company (GPC)' in connection with the SOUTHERN fields (the Abu Sennan gas/condensate plant, 85 mmcf/d), a different operator area from Qasr/Shams in the north — so GPC looks like a transcription mix-up. Owner/operator should read Khalda Petroleum Company (with Apache as operator; EGPC as the state partner).

validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed. The line is a real Qasr-field export pipeline. The sheet's cited PDF (Egypt Oil & Gas, 'The Western Desert', March 2020, Issue 159) contains an explicit 'Natural Gas Infrastructure in the Western Desert' table row: 'Qasr-Shams | Qasr -> Shams | 40 km | 24 in | 350 mmcf/d' (the ref-sweep substring screen FAILED this URL only because it is a PDF; -layout text extraction shows the row verbatim, so the cited source DOES support endpoints + all three specs). Independent trade/technical coverage (OGJ/Hart/AAPG) describes Qasr gas+condensate free-flowing from the Qasr Phase I/II facilities through export pipelines to the SHAMS manifold and Salam gas plant — corroborating both existence and the Qasr->Shams direction. CLASSIFICATION (caveat): this is an upstream field-export/gathering line carrying unprocessed gas+condensate within a single concession, not a dry-gas transmission trunk; GEM classes the whole Western Desert roster from this one table as 'transmission', and at 24 in/40 km/350 mmcf/d it is trunk-scale, so I leave the class but flag the nuance. DUPLICATE: none. GulfPub 'Qasr GP - Shams Pipeline' (24 in, KPC) is the SAME pipe (a corroborating match, not a GEM double-count); roster neighbours P6688 Shams-Obaiyed (42 km/18 in) and P6693 Salam Spurline (35 km/22 in) are distinct rows in the very same source table. SPEC: diameter 24 in is corroborated by two independent origins (Egypt O&G table + GulfPub) -> high. Length 40 km and capacity 350 mmcf/d rest on the single Egypt O&G table (GulfPub gives 24 km, ~40% shorter, and its Capacity_mmcfd=300 is a placeholder), so both are medium/single-sourced, not independently confirmed. ENDPOINTS: Qasr field and Shams manifold are both in the Shushan-Matrouh basin, Matruh governorate (Qasr ~50 km south of the Mediterranean, per peer-reviewed field studies) — consistent with the sheet's Start/End = Qasr/Shams, Matruh.

fills.researcher_notes: Location [ref] was blank in the sheet. Endpoints Qasr (start) and Shams (end) are given by the Egypt Oil & Gas Western Desert table (the row also cited for the other cells); the peer-reviewed Qasr-field study locates the field in the Shushan-Matrouh basin, north Western Desert (Matruh governorate), ~50 km south of the Mediterranean, between 30 deg 36'-39' N and 26 deg 41'-44' E, confirming the Matruh-governorate placement of both endpoints (Shams manifold sits within the same Khalda concession).

routes.start_name: Qasr field / Qasr gas plant (manifold), Khalda Concession
routes.end_name: Shams manifold / gas receiving station, Khalda Concession
routes.corridor_desc: Short (~40 km per Egypt O&G; ~24 km per GulfPub) intra-concession export line in the Khalda Concession, Shushan-Matrouh basin, northern Western Desert, Matruh governorate. It runs from the Qasr Phase I/II facilities/manifold (~30.62 N, 26.71 E, ~50 km south of the Mediterranean coast and west of the Qattara Depression) to the Shams manifold/gas-receiving station a short distance to the north/east, from which the Shams-Obaiyed line (P6688) continues toward the Obaiyed plant (Obaiyed is ~35 km SW of Marsa Matruh). Start coordinate is sourced from peer-reviewed field studies; the Shams end is bounded to the Qasr-Obaiyed corridor within the concession but its precise point is not independently sourced, so it is left null rather than fabricated. Corridor bound is loose (a few tens of km).
routes.researcher_notes: Qasr field coordinates (30 deg 36'-39' N, 26 deg 41'-44' E -> midpoint ~30.625 N, 26.71 E) taken from a peer-reviewed Qasr-field seismic/geology study; used the field/manifold centroid as the start. Shams manifold has no independently published coordinate I could verify, so end lat/lon left null and described in prose (avoided fabricating a point). Direction Qasr->Shams corroborated by OGJ/Hart trade coverage of Qasr export routing to the Shams manifold.

summary: P6692 Qasr-Shams real & correctly gas, but ATTRIBUTION concern (Owner 'General Petroleum Co' wrong -> Khalda Petroleum Company/Apache); specs single-sourced (Egypt O&G table; length 40 vs GulfPub 24).
